types.label: Orchestrator demo notification
types.description: The guided live demo's own phone notification, title marked [demo]: sent once per run by the "A notification reaches the phone" act to show what a build notification looks like. Nothing real happened. A tap opens the Builds page.

types.label: Orchestrator demo break alert
types.description: The break alert of a demo build that died for good during the guided live demo, title marked [demo] ("Build failed: …" with what failed). Only ever about a throwaway demo- build; removed when the run ends.
